evidence: Actual catalog cards say60–75min for five-lesson tracks and36–45min for three-lesson tracks; Course JSON-LD saysPT75M/PT45M. The same authored lesson readingMinutes sum to44,40,40,41 minutes for bundled tracks and24,18,15 for published tracks. CourseTrack schema already sums authored readingMinutes. Catalog FAQ calls the cards estimated reading time and excludes extra quizzes/worksheets.
rootCause: Catalog uses fixed12–15minutes per lesson and fixed15min schema instead of authored per-lesson values.
skepticalPass: Reading estimates are not promises of actual user completion time. The defect is inconsistent representation of the same authored estimate, not proof of an empirically false duration or a Google policy violation. The root FAQ explicitly calls this reading time; treating the larger range as total study time would conflict with that qualification.
proposedFix: Sum authored readingMinutes for card reading label and catalog Course schema, aligned with CourseTrack. Explicitly label estimated reading time; keep quizzes/worksheets additional. Do not alter lesson estimates, publication, content or user progress.
deduplication: No equivalent duration/catalog reading-time finding found in inspected historical/current ledgers; same source cause counted once across seven tracks, not seven defects.
acceptance: All seven actual current course cards and Course schemas match their authored sums.
